title: Noema: Local Knowledge Graph & GraphRAG Workspace
description: Built a local-first knowledge workspace that transforms notes and documents into an interactive knowledge graph, combining AI-powered entity and relationship extraction, semantic search, and GraphRAG retrieval to answer questions with connected knowledge and source context. Includes configurable LLM providers, private user profiles, and a standalone public graph showcase.

title: Market Event Decision System
description: Built an interactive Streamlit decision-support dashboard to study how major 2020–2025 market events affect cross-asset prices, volatility, and investor narratives across equities, bonds, gold, USD, sectors, and VIX.

title: TikCheck: Trustworthy Review Intelligence
description: Developed an NLP pipeline combining rule-based checks and deep learning models to analyze Google Local Reviews, improve review trustworthiness, and generate insights across users, creators, businesses, platforms, and regulators.

title: MiroFish: Multi-Agent Prediction Engine Fork
description: Forked and refined MiroFish, a multi-agent AI prediction engine that builds high-fidelity digital worlds from seed information and simulates future scenarios through swarm intelligence and agent interaction.

title: NUS Datathon 2025 Winner: Agent–Client Matching Recommendation System
description: Built a scalable recommendation system using Siamese neural networks and XGBoost to match agents with clients across 28 regions, achieving strong predictive performance and winning NUS Datathon 2025.

title: Reinforcement Learning Trading Strategies
description: Developed and benchmarked portfolio optimization models including GMV, Market Portfolio, and Risk Parity to evaluate reinforcement learning trading strategies on 30 Dow Jones stocks.

title: Systematic Quantitative Trading Strategy
description: Implemented a long-only quantitative trading system using MACD divergence signals, ATR-based trailing stops, stop-loss rules, partial exits, walk-forward testing, and Bayesian hyperparameter optimization.

title: Quantify: Stock Forecasting System
description: Developed a stock price forecasting project using ARIMA and GARCH models with a Flask interface, applying statistical time-series methods to financial market prediction.

title: Spotifynd: Spotify Recommendation System
description: Built a personalized music recommendation system that curates playlists based on user listening habits and preferences.

title: Hack&Roll 2025: CourseRank
description: Created a platform that ranks and compares university courses using multiple metrics to help students make more informed academic decisions.
